_comment: Canned reads — THE workshop case. Every green light is on: onboarded, planned, backups completing, SLA met, and a restore has genuinely proven recovery works. And it still must not promote, because the recovery point itself carries a threat. Available is not the same as trusted. Blocks at Scan, state RECOVERABLE. This is the offline mirror of `op incident` → `op backup` → `op threatscan` on a live workload.
